app.name: Atlas
app.tagline: The whole history of the world in one app

globe.title: The whole world, any year
globe.sub: Drag the slider from −10000 to today: states of that era light up on the globe. Tap any one to open its history.

path.title: From the first humans to today
path.sub: Twelve eras, several chapters in each. The order is suggested, but nothing is locked: open anything, anytime.

reference.title: Countries, people, events
reference.sub: Every state and empire, rulers, dynasties and family trees. Every fact carries a link to its source.
reference.searchPlaceholder: A country, a person, a war, a dynasty…
reference.noBookmarks: No bookmarks yet. Open a card and press “Bookmark”.
reference.browseNote: {{count}} cards live on this device and open without the internet. Everything else loads from Wikidata.

review.title: Come back to what fades
review.sub: The app returns a fact to you exactly when it starts slipping out of memory.

profile.title: Your path
profile.sub: Experience, level, day streak and achievements. Progress is stored on this device.

settings.title: However suits you

language.title: Language
language.sub: One choice sets both the menus and the language of names and descriptions in the reference.

motion.title: Reduce motion
motion.sub: Turns off smooth transitions and globe rotation.

globe3d.title: 3D globe
globe3d.sub: Turn off if your device stutters: you get a flat map instead of a sphere.

music.title: Background music
music.sub: Calm lo-fi while you read. Off by default.

sound.title: Page sounds
sound.sub: A quiet rustle when you turn a page.

progress.title: Progress
progress.sub: Progress lives on this device. To move it to another one, save a file here and load it there.
progress.resetConfirm: Erase all progress on this device? This cannot be undone.
progress.loadFailed: Could not read the file: it is not from Atlas or it is damaged

settings.sub: Language, theme, text size, music and progress transfer — all in one place.

sources.title: Sources and licences
sources.bordersNote: Historical borders are approximate: before the Peace of Westphalia (1648) sharp lines on a map simply did not exist. Each snapshot carries the author's own precision rating.
sources.sub: Atlas invents nothing. Every fact comes from open databases, and every card carries a link so you can check it yourself.

common.offline: No connection — showing what is stored on this device

entity.notFound: Card {{id}} was found neither on this device nor online.
entity.noArticle: There is no article in your language. Showing what Wikidata knows.
entity.sourcesNote: Everything on this page comes from here. Any fact can be checked by following a link.
